title: Hybrid AI-Powered Digital Clone for Real-Time Health Monitoring and Legacy Preservation

core_architecture: a central digital-clone representation coordinates multiple specialized modules
a monitoring/guardian layer continuously ingests time-varying signals
a memory archivist converts multimedia and structured records into an indexed searchable timeline
an AI interface supports text and voice interaction with the evolving representation
graph-based learning links related events and signals across time
meta-learning adapts behavior to user-specific patterns without treating every update as a full retraining cycle
real-time data transport and time-series storage support continuously changing state
major actions remain subject to explicit user control rather than autonomous execution
gpt_doug_reuse: generalize Health Guardian into State Guardian for runtime, sensor, system, and operator-state monitoring
map Memory Archivist to GPT-Doug episodic, semantic, and procedural memory with provenance
map AI Interface to the Replit embodiment, voice, text, and body-state surfaces
use graph-linked context to connect missions, observations, files, agents, outcomes, and memories
use meta-learning only to propose bounded preference/procedure updates that pass validation
use event streams to synchronize local GPT-Doug, GPT-Chaos, Universal Hive, and remote body nodes
preserve explicit human approval for external side effects and consequential actions

publicly_described_functional_concepts: continuously ingest changing signals into an evolving digital representation
correlate current observations with historical context through graph-based relationships
adapt personalized behavior through meta-learning and feedback
archive text, audio, video, and structured records into a searchable memory timeline
retrieve and synthesize cross-modal memories through an interactive AI interface
use real-time streaming between sensors, compute, and storage layers
retain human control over major actions and decisions
support a persistent representation that evolves as new verified data arrives

claim_scope_signals.independent_claim_theme: a digital-clone system combining a monitoring/guardian module, a multimedia memory archivist, and an interactive AI interface, with predictive/adaptive AI and user-controlled actions
dependent_claim_signals: secure storage of continuously collected records
EEG, ECG, MRI and wearable inputs in healthcare embodiments
explicit user control over major actions
claim_scope_signals.legal_scope_rule: The controlling claims, prosecution history, continuations, legal status, territorial scope, and later amendments must be checked in the official record before infringement, licensing, or freedom-to-operate conclusions.

design_divergence_defaults: use a generalized State Guardian rather than reproducing the source healthcare module
separate episodic, semantic, and procedural memory rather than copying the source storage layout
derive GPT-Doug's graph schema from missions, tools, agents, outcomes, and provenance
treat meta-learning as bounded proposal generation, never as unreviewed self-modification
require explicit user consent before storing sensitive personal data
do not infer medical diagnoses or emergency conditions from this patent architecture
do not create posthumous or identity-replicating personas without explicit authorization and provenance
do not commit secrets, private health data, or raw credentials into shared memory stores
preserve reversible updates, audit logs, provenance, and human approval for consequential actions

mandatory_safety_boundaries: no autonomous medical diagnosis or treatment
no emergency dispatch based solely on an unvalidated model
no storage of secrets in learned memory
no identity cloning without explicit authorization
no external side effects without existing authorization controls
all adaptations retain provenance and are reversible where feasible
